title: Guarantee Readjustments and Their Parts — Alignment Services & Plans Plan Desk Policy
content:
**Alignment Services & Plans — open readjustments.** A store that readjusts an alignment measured out of specification posts the readjustment on the plan with the alignment it corrects, its date and odometer, the replacement parts it installed at their list price as the parts charge, and its service basis left open (none). That readjustment is the **open readjustment**, and the plan desk books it as a guarantee readjustment when the conditions of the readjustment guarantee hold (the guarantee period and mileage, the vehicle measured out of specification, and a cause outside the line's exclusions). Once booked, the readjustment's service basis shows guarantee readjustment.

For an open readjustment that the plan desk books under this policy, and only for such a readjustment, the readjustment labor is free (a labor charge of 0.00) and the parts charge is the amount this policy prices from the parts the store listed. Every other readjustment has free labor (a labor charge of 0.00) and charges the parts it needs, under the parts warranty only when the part itself failed within the line's parts warranty months and miles.

| Readjustment | Labor | Parts |
|---|---|---|
| Open readjustment booked by the plan desk under this policy | 0.00 | priced under this policy from the parts the store listed |
| Every other readjustment | 0.00 | the parts it needs, under the parts warranty only when the part itself failed within the line's parts warranty months and miles |

## Tool reference — `price_alignment_readjustment_e00d4c5e`

**Capability.** Confirms an open readjustment as a free guarantee readjustment and sets its parts charge: the readjustment is booked as a guarantee readjustment with no labor charged, and the listed parts figure is replaced with the parts amount the customer is charged. On success the readjustment shows service basis `guarantee_readjustment`, labor 0.00 and the parts charge given; the alignment it corrects, its date and its odometer are left as they are.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `price_alignment_readjustment_e00d4c5e` and calls it.

**Parameters.**
- `alignment_event_id` — reference number of the open readjustment (a readjustment entry on the plan whose service basis is none), from the plan's alignment activity lookup (text).
- `source_alignment_event_id` — reference number of the alignment the readjustment corrects (an alignment performed entry on the same plan), from the plan's alignment activity lookup (text).
- `parts_charge` — parts charged on the readjustment, USD, a non-negative amount with 2 decimal places; rounded to the nearest cent by the tool when more digits are given; 0.00 when no parts are charged.

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `alignment_event_id`, `source_alignment_event_id`, `service_basis` (the text `guarantee_readjustment`), `charge_amount` (labor booked, always 0.0), `parts_charge` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `status` with the text `readjustment_priced`, confirming the readjustment is booked. No error return is defined for this tool.
